units.source_text: 隅田川的天气阴沉沉的。

en.t: The weather over the Sumida River was gloomy and overcast.

units.source_text: 他从行进中的小汽船窗口向外眺望向岛的樱树。

en.t: From the window of the little steamboat as it moved along, he gazed out at the cherry trees of Mukojima.

units.source_text: 在他视线中，绽放的樱花好似一片败絮般令人忧郁。

en.t: In his eyes, the blooming cherry blossoms were as melancholy as a stretch of worn-out cotton batting.

units.source_text: 但是他在那些樱树中——江户时代以来的向岛的樱树中看见了他自己。

en.t: But among those cherry trees, among the cherry trees of Mukojima that had stood since the Edo period, he saw himself.
